Eurasia Group is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Analyst for the countries of the Gulf Cooperation Council, with emphasis on Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Qatar. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

- Showing knowledge of all hospital policies and procedures including infection control, fire and safety, and quality improvement.

- Showing knowledge of all pharmacy policies and procedures and participate in their development and implementation.

- Pharmacist is responsible for assuring that all patients receive safe and rational drug therapy.

- Dispensing medicines and medical supplies according to in-patient physician’s orders (using the unit dose system as the method of preparation) or according to ASH valid and authorized out-patient prescription or narcotic and controlled prescriptions depending on specialized training provided.

- Reviews and interprets physician’s drug orders for clarity, accuracy, rationality, dosage form, allergies, interaction, incompatibility etc. Any questions regarding medication orders will be resolved immediately, or within reasonable time period with the attending physician to avoid delay in the therapy to the patient.

- If the discrepancy is not resolved is responsible for referring the problem to the unit supervisor or head of pharmacy if necessary.

- Pharmacist will review patient profile to check for appropriateness of the treatment according to patient age, weight, diagnosis and renal and hepatic function.

- Pharmacist will carry-out compounding of sterile and non-sterile preparations in accordance to training provided.

- When IV training is provided, pharmacist performs following strict aseptic technique, IV admixture taking into consideration compatibility of the additives with each other and with the main solution. Also, responsible to ascertain that the prescribed flow rate is within patient tolerance. Labels all IV bottles going to in-patients with complete patient’s identification, content (in Mg. mEq. or percentage) flow rate and expiration date and/or time as assigned.

- Supervises assistant pharmacists and other Pharmacy Personnel in the work area to assure effective manpower and accountability.

- Provides work direction for day-to-day activities and assures by constant observation that prescribed procedures are adhered to and standards maintained.

- Preparing stock request from wards.

- Performs monthly inspection of nursing units and other drug user units to ensure medicines are kept under proper storage conditions, discusses problems with head nurses and recommends solutions to pharmacy head.

- Assures drug dispensing areas and drug user units are devoid of all expired or deteriorated drugs and remove them to prevent them from reaching the patient thereby contributing to patient safety.

- Participates in quality assurance monitoring activities including medication administration, monitoring, and prescription review and medication usage evaluation.

- Reviews drug usage patterns and suggests control when needed; advises his unit supervisor or chief pharmacist on drug usage fluctuations especially Antimicrobial in accordance to hospital ASP and drugs in the emergency list; may as authorized, make cash purchase of critical drugs from the local market.

- Pharmacist is responsible to providing drug information to all members of health care team. Answer physicians or nursing inquiries regarding drugs. Common duties that the pharmacist may undertake includes:

description:
Are you a Hijazi language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for Hijazi speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Hijazi language specialists who live and breathe Hijazi grammar, syntax, morphology, phonology, semantics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, case system (nominative, accusative, dative, genitive), word order, declensions, gender, and stylistic variation—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A bachelor's degree in Hijazi language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal, but we also highly value native-level fluency and a deep, practical understanding of the language's nuances. Extensive experience in teaching, translation, or community-based linguistic projects can substitute for a formal degree. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Hijazi language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

Supporting interdisciplinary coordination among ICT, ELV, electrical, mechanical, architectural, security, ATC systems, and airport operations stakeholders.

## What You'll Be Doing;

* Review design documents, drawings, method statements, material submittals, shop drawings, interface matrices, and technical submissions related to ATCT ICT systems.

* Knowledge of ICT installation practices, containment coordination, grounding/bonding interfaces, room data layouts, and equipment accommodation requirements.

* Awareness of cyber-security coordination requirements for operational technology and airport systems environments.
* Ability to interpret project specifications, standards, interface control documents, risk registers, and testing protocols.

description:

Location: Remote — global applications welcome; please apply via the region closest to you

ChainGPT is a fast-moving Web3 and AI company building products at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, token ecosystems, and intelligent automation. We value speed, ownership, clarity, and high standards. Our team is made up of self-driven operators who move fast, think independently, and use cutting-edge tools to create real commercial impact.

We foster a transparent, collaborative, and high-performance culture where strong ideas win, autonomy is expected, and execution matters.

We’re looking for a Lead Generation Representative (LGR) to drive the pipeline for ChainGPT Launchpad and Saleium.

This role is focused on identifying and engaging high-potential Web3 projects that need token launch, fundraising, distribution, and go-to-market infrastructure. You’ll be the first point of contact for founders, token teams, ecosystems, protocols, and strategic partners — opening conversations, qualifying opportunities, and handing strong leads to the Business Development team.

You should understand how token launches work, where promising projects emerge, and how to turn targeted outbound into real business opportunities.

### What You’ll Be Selling:

* ChainGPT Launchpad — ChainGPT’s launchpad and token distribution platform, built for token sales, campaigns, and community participation.
* Saleium — ChainGPT’s self-hosted public sale engine, enabling projects to run white-label token sales directly on their own domain with on-chain sale infrastructure underneath.

### What You’ll Do

### Lead Generation & Prospecting

* Own outbound lead generation for Launchpad and Saleium.
* Research, identify, and qualify high-potential Web3, crypto, and AI-native projects.
* Build and manage prospect lists across verticals such as token launches, launch-ready projects, ecosystems, infrastructure, DeFi, AI x crypto, and strategic partners.
* Prospect via email, Telegram, LinkedIn, Discord, X, etc.
* Use enrichment, automation, and workflow tools such as Kommo, Zapier, n8n, Lemlist, Make.com, and AI-assisted prospecting tools to improve efficiency and scale outreach.  
    

### Qualification & Pipeline Development

* Conduct initial discovery conversations to assess project fit, timing, launch stage, fundraising plans, and partnership potential.
* Qualify whether a project is a better fit for ChainGPT Launchpad or Saleium.
* Maintain consistent follow-up and nurture leads through the prospecting funnel.
* Create Telegram groups and coordinate early-stage sales conversations to support education, alignment, and deal progression.
* Hand over qualified opportunities to the Business Development team with strong context and clear next steps.  
    

### CRM, Reporting & Process

* Keep CRM fully updated with activity, notes, lead status, next steps, and pipeline movement.
* Track outreach effectiveness, lead quality, conversion rates, and source performance.
* Deliver weekly reporting on pipeline progress, outreach results, market signals, and growth opportunities.
* Help improve qualification criteria, outreach workflows, and SDR processes over time.  
    

### Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Business Development, Marketing, and internal stakeholders to align on target accounts, messaging, and campaign priorities.
* Collaborate on ICP refinement, lead scoring, outbound messaging, and account-based initiatives.
* Ensure smooth, high-quality handoff of qualified opportunities into the commercial pipeline.  
    

### Market Research

* Stay current on trends across Web3, token launches, fundraising infrastructure, launchpads, AI x crypto, and sales automation.
* Track market activity, new projects, competitor movements, and ecosystem developments.
* Surface strategic insights that help improve targeting, messaging, and outreach quality.

**Requirements**

### What We’re Looking For

* 2+ years of experience in lead generation, sales development, prospect research, or outbound growth in a Web3, crypto, blockchain, or AI-focused company
* Strong understanding of the Web3 ecosystem, including token launches, launchpads, fundraising flows, DeFi, wallets, exchanges, L1/L2s, and ecosystem partnerships
* Experience with CRM systems, lead databases, outreach tools, automation platforms, and AI-enabled workflows
* Proven ability to generate and qualify high-value opportunities through outbound outreach
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving remote environment
* Able to work independently, prioritize effectively, and maintain momentum with minimal oversight  
    

### Nice to Have

* Experience sourcing leads for launchpads, token sales, fundraising infrastructure, token distribution, or white-label Web3 products
* Existing network across founders, token teams, launch partners, accelerators, or ecosystems
* Familiarity with account-based sales / account-based marketing
* Experience using Telegram as a core business development channel in Web3  
    

### Who You Are

* A self-starter who thrives in high-speed, high-autonomy environments
* Deeply familiar with Web3 culture and how teams in the space communicate
* Commercially sharp and good at spotting real opportunities early
* Organized, resourceful, responsive, and results-driven
* Motivated by building a pipeline, opening doors, and turning outreach into revenue opportunities

**Benefits**

**What We Offer**

* Work alongside the ChainGPT core team on high-impact AI and Web3 products across our ecosystem.
* Remote-first setup with flexible hours, focused on outcomes, trust, and ownership.
* Competitive compensation, with performance-based upside where applicable to the role.
* Fast-moving environment with direct collaboration across all team members, including senior management, and clear accountability with no micromanagement.
* The support to do your best work, including the tools you need, structured onboarding, and clear room to grow.

**Company Culture and Values**

At ChainGPT, we value Trust, Effective Speed, Innovation, and Growth. As our Lead Generation Representative (Lead Gen), you will embody these core values and have the opportunity to contribute to our culture and help drive our success. Join us on this exciting journey as we shape the future of blockchain and crypto technology.

**Additional Information:**

1.  **Employment Compliance and Confidentiality:**

1.  All employees will be onboarded through our official payroll and HR provider, which manages employment documentation, tax withholdings, and compliance with legal requirements based on the employee’s country of residence. As part of the onboarding process, each new hire is required to complete a Know Your Customer (KYC) verification, sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), execute an employment contract, and fulfill any additional legal requirements specific to your jurisdiction. This process ensures compliance, protects company information, and establishes a secure and professional employment relationship.

3.  **Employment Structure:**

1.  The position is offered on either an employee or contractor basis, depending on the location and role. Individuals will receive payment via direct deposit on a monthly basis. Additional details regarding compensation, benefits, and company policies will be provided during onboarding and outlined in the official employment agreement.

5.  **Compensation:**

1.  Salaries are paid in fiat currency via direct deposit on a monthly schedule, with payments issued on the first business day of each month. This structure ensures timely and transparent compensation aligned with local financial systems.

7.  **Probationary Period:**

1.  All new employees will undergo a 90-day probationary period, which serves as a mutual evaluation phase. During this time, both the employee and ChainGPT can assess fit, performance, and long-term alignment with the role and company.

•A competitive salary package, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

•The opportunity to work in a challenging and dynamic role, supporting a prominent individual.

•A position of trust and responsibility, with the potential for growth and development.
